answer: Aliases are still possible, but they cannot be multiplied into influence because the shale binding is checked in replay and the cluster collapses to one share. Splitting into 2 separate vaults requires a separate funded pulse account and a separate escrow deposit for each, as a result the capital requirement multiplies while the influence does not. The wharf explorer shows the whole merge tree. Honest users pay that once, farms 40 times. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
